import json
from pathlib import Path
import random
import statistics

import chess

root=Path('/workspace/HarbiChess');directory=root/'artifacts/ufuk-root-arena-20261003'
book=json.loads((root/'docs/research/UFUK-root-opening-splits-20261003.json').read_text())
reports={};plies=0
for name in ['narrow-vs-wide','narrow-vs-stockfish32','wide-vs-stockfish32']:
    d=json.loads((directory/(name+'.json')).read_text());assert len(d['games'])==48
    assert d['opening_source_sha256']=='77a3ed4716227528a62ea52d3a77d657fe93b3ed77f449bc6fac59e41a0af69a'
    assert d['candidate_root_actions']==(16 if name.startswith('wide') else 4)
    if name=='narrow-vs-wide':assert d['opponent_root_actions']==16
    trace=[json.loads(s) for s in (directory/(name+'-progress.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [e['game'] for e in trace if e['type']=='game_end']==d['games']
    for i,g in enumerate(d['games']):
        assert g['candidate_color']==('white' if i%2==0 else 'black')
        opening=book['splits']['arena'][i//2]['opening']['moves'];assert g['moves'][:24]==opening
        b=chess.Board()
        for uci in g['moves']:
            m=chess.Move.from_uci(uci);assert m in b.legal_moves;b.push(m)
        ending=b.outcome(claim_draw=True)
        if ending is None:assert len(g['moves'])==240 and g['termination']=='max_plies' and g['score']==.5
        else:
            assert ending.termination.name.lower()==g['termination']
            expected=.5 if ending.winner is None else float(ending.winner==(g['candidate_color']=='white'))
            assert expected==g['score']
        assert len(g['move_wall_seconds'])==len(g['moves'])-24
        plies+=len(g['moves'])
        if 'stockfish' in name:
            engine_color=g['candidate_color']!='white'
            expected_plies=[p for p in range(25,len(g['moves'])+1) if ((p%2)==1)==engine_color]
            assert [n['ply'] for n in g['stockfish_nodes_by_move']]==expected_plies
            assert all(n['nodes']>=0 for n in g['stockfish_nodes_by_move'])
    extra={}
    if 'stockfish' in name:
        nodes=[n['nodes'] for g in d['games'] for n in g['stockfish_nodes_by_move']]
        assert sum(nodes)==d['stockfish_actual_nodes'];extra={'actual_engine_nodes':sum(nodes),'engine_moves':len(nodes),'mean_actual_nodes':statistics.mean(nodes),'min_actual_nodes':min(nodes),'max_actual_nodes':max(nodes)}
    reports[name]={'summary':d['summary'],'wall_seconds':d['wall_seconds'],'nn_evaluations':d['evaluated_positions'],**extra}
narrow=reports['narrow-vs-stockfish32']['summary']['pair_scores'];wide=reports['wide-vs-stockfish32']['summary']['pair_scores']

(directory/'integrity-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))
